language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and grasps the wooden spoon at frames 41–64 (image, left_ego_image, wrist_image), then lifts and carries it toward the open drawer at frames 70–128 (image, left_ego_image). At frames 129–134, wrist_image shows the gripper releasing the spoon into the drawer; frames 135–140 show the spoon remaining inside as the empty gripper withdraws. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
